title: Infant High Chair Spring Failure Incident
premise: A parent in London reported that her infant’s high chair retracted unexpectedly, dropping the child to the floor, due to a faulty spring mechanism in the folding frame.

side_A.role: an advocate at a consumer-safety group
side_A.goal: pushing for a recall of the product

side_B.goal: showing the product is safe when used as directed

documents:
=== DOCUMENT 1: Incident Report and Product Inspection Log ===

**Case Reference:** OBG-2023-0314-LEO
**Date of Report:** March 21, 2023
**Prepared By:** Quality Assurance Department, Oakline Baby Gear
**Subject:** Investigation into SteadySeat Pro High Chair Incident

**1. Incident Overview**
This report details the investigation into the incident involving a SteadySeat Pro high chair (Model: SS-PRO-01) owned by Sarah Jenkins. The incident occurred at 14:32 on March 14, 2023, within a residential flat located in Camden, London. The infant involved, Leo, was 11 months old at the time of the event. The chair in question bears Batch Number 2301-042.

**2. Product History and Usage**
Records indicate that the subject unit was purchased by the consumer on January 5, 2023, from a local retailer for a sum of £120.00. According to the consumer’s usage logs, the chair was utilized daily for approximately 60 days prior to the incident. The product was not part of any recall action in the United Kingdom prior to March 14, 2023. Oakline Baby Gear offers a 2-year warranty on all mechanical parts, which covers the period of the incident.

**3. Physical Inspection of the Unit**
The chair was returned to our facility on March 18, 2023, for inspection. The inspection focused primarily on the folding mechanism and the structural integrity of the frame.

*   **Spring Mechanism:** The spring mechanism is located in the left rear leg of the folding frame. Upon disassembly, the spring assembly was found to be intact. There was no evidence of a snapped or fractured spring component. The locking pin mechanism appeared to be in a disengaged state.
*   **Shell Integrity:** An examination of the plastic shell revealed no visible signs of impact damage prior to the incident. The exterior surfaces were free of cracks, chips, or deformation consistent with a violent collision or structural failure.
*   **Standard Compliance:** The batch (2301-042) passed ISO 8974:2017 safety standards during batch testing. This certification confirms that the design and manufacturing process met the required safety thresholds for mechanical integrity and stability.

**4. Environmental Context**
The incident took place in a dining room with a smooth parquet floor. The chair was positioned on this surface at the time of the event. The smoothness of the parquet floor is noted as a potential factor in the movement of the chair base during the retraction event.

**5. Safety Protocol Observations**
The user manual for the SteadySeat Pro explicitly warns that the five-point safety harness must be secured before use. This warning is printed in bold text on page 4 of the manual and is reiterated in the safety checklist section.

**6. Medical Documentation**
A medical record dated March 14, 2023, from a General Practitioner (GP) confirms that the infant sustained a bruise on the left thigh. The injury was documented as a contusion consistent with a fall from a low height.

**7. Resolution Status**
On March 20, 2023, Oakline Baby Gear provided a replacement SteadySeat Pro unit to Sarah Jenkins. The original unit remains in our possession for further forensic analysis.

***

=== DOCUMENT 2: Witness Statement of Sarah Jenkins (Parent) ===

**To:** Oakline Baby Gear, Customer Relations
**From:** Sarah Jenkins
**Date:** March 15, 2023
**Re:** Complaint regarding SteadySeat Pro High Chair Failure

To Whom It May Concern,

I am writing to formally complain about the dangerous failure of the SteadySeat Pro high chair I purchased from your company. My son, Leo, who is 11 months old, was injured when the chair collapsed suddenly. This is not an isolated event; the chair has been behaving erratically for days, and your company ignored my warnings.

I bought this chair on January 5, 2023, for £120. It has been used daily for about 60 days. I always follow the instructions, but the product itself is defective.

On March 10, 2023, I noticed a 'clicking' sound coming from the left rear leg of the chair. It was distinct and concerning. I called your customer support line on March 12, 2023, specifically to report this clicking sound. The agent I spoke with told me to ignore it, stating it was likely just settling. I did not believe this, but I hoped it was harmless.

The incident occurred at 14:32 on March 14, 2023, in our dining room in Camden. The chair was sitting on our smooth parquet floor. Leo was in the chair, and I had the five-point safety harness fastened and secured. I am certain of this because I always buckle him in before he eats.

Suddenly, the chair retracted. It happened in under two seconds. I heard a loud, distinct cracking sound immediately before the drop. It was not a standard mechanical sound; it was the sound of something breaking. The spring mechanism snapped internally, causing the chair to collapse suddenly. Leo was thrown from the seat. Although the harness was on, the force of the collapse was so violent that he slipped out of the restraints. He fell onto the hard parquet floor and sustained a bruise on his left thigh.

Your company claims the chair passed safety standards, but a product that snaps and throws a child is not safe. I am requesting a full investigation and compensation for the injury and the distress caused.

Sincerely,

Sarah Jenkins

***

=== DOCUMENT 3: Witness Statement of David Thorne (Head of Communications, Oakline Baby Gear) ===

**To:** Internal Legal Team
**From:** David Thorne
**Date:** March 22, 2023
**Re:** Statement on Incident OBG-2023-0314-LEO

For the record, I wish to clarify the facts surrounding the incident involving the SteadySeat Pro unit owned by Sarah Jenkins. It is imperative that the public and our legal team understand the true nature of this event, which appears to have been misrepresented by the consumer.

The chair did not break. The locking pin failed to engage due to user error during folding. This is a standard mechanical function that was gone wrong because the user did not follow the assembly and safety protocols outlined in the manual.

Regarding the claim of a "snapped spring," our forensic inspection of the unit (Batch 2301-042) shows no internal fracture. The spring mechanism in the left rear leg is intact. The retraction was caused by the failure of the locking pin to hold the frame in the upright position. This is a known risk if the user does not ensure the pin clicks into place.

Ms. Jenkins claims she heard a "loud, distinct cracking sound." We dispute this. There was no abnormal sound; the retraction was a standard mechanical function gone wrong due to improper assembly. The sounds associated with the chair operating are normal for this model.

Furthermore, Ms. Jenkins claims she called customer support on March 12, 2023, to report a "clicking" sound. I must correct this. No contact was made with support prior to the incident. Our call logs show no record of a call from Ms. Jenkins on March 12. The first time we received any communication from her regarding this issue was via email on March 15, 2023, after the incident had already occurred.

Regarding the safety harness, Ms. Jenkins states it was fastened and that the child slipped out. This is incorrect. The harness was not engaged; the child fell freely from the seat base. If the harness had been properly secured, as the manual explicitly warns it must be, the child would have remained in the seat even if the chair retracted. The fact that the child fell freely indicates that the harness was not used, which is a direct violation of the user manual's safety requirements.

We have already provided a replacement chair on March 20, 2023, to resolve the customer service aspect, but we must stand by our position that the product is safe and compliant with ISO 8974:2017 standards.

David Thorne
Head of Communications
Oakline Baby Gear

***

=== DOCUMENT 4: Medical Record and GP Note ===

**Patient Name:** Leo Jenkins
**Date of Birth:** [Redacted]
**Age:** 11 months
**Date of Visit:** March 14, 2023
**Time:** 16:15
**Clinician:** Dr. A. Patel, GP
**Location:** Camden Health Centre

**Reason for Visit:**
Mother reports fall from high chair at home. Patient sustained injury to left leg.

**History of Presenting Complaint:**
Mother states that the high chair collapsed at 14:32. She reports that the chair dropped suddenly, causing the patient to fall onto the floor. The floor is described as smooth parquet.

**Examination:**
*   **General:** Patient is alert and responsive. No signs of head trauma. No vomiting.
*   **Left Thigh:** Palpable tenderness over the lateral aspect of the left thigh. Bruising (ecchymosis) noted, approximately 5cm in diameter, located on the left thigh.
*   **Other:** No other injuries noted. Hip stability is normal. Range of motion is preserved, though limited by pain.

**Assessment:**
Contusion to left thigh secondary to fall.

**Plan:**
1.  Ice pack to affected area for 20 minutes every 3 hours for the first 48 hours.
2.  Paracetamol as per weight-based dosage for pain management.
3.  Review if symptoms worsen or if there is any difficulty walking/weight-bearing.
4.  Advise parents to ensure safety harnesses are used for all seating equipment.

**Note:**
The bruising is consistent with a blunt force impact from a fall from a low height. The severity is minor, but parents should monitor for any swelling.

***

**From:** Sarah Jenkins <s.jenkins@example.com>
**To:** support@oaklinebabygear.com
**Date:** March 15, 2023, 09:14 AM
**Subject:** Urgent: Complaint regarding SteadySeat Pro Incident

Dear Oakline Baby Gear,

I am writing to submit a formal complaint regarding the SteadySeat Pro high chair (Batch 2301-042) that I purchased on January 5, 2023.

As detailed in my attached written complaint, the chair failed catastrophically on March 14, 2023, at 14:32. My 11-month-old son, Leo, was injured in the incident. I had previously contacted your support line on March 12, 2023, to report a concerning clicking sound from the left rear leg, but was dismissed.

The chair retracted suddenly, and despite the harness being fastened, Leo was thrown from the seat. I am requesting a full review of this incident and a response regarding the safety of this product.

Regards,

Sarah Jenkins

**From:** support@oaklinebabygear.com
**To:** Sarah Jenkins <s.jenkins@example.com>
**Date:** March 16, 2023, 11:02 AM
**Subject:** Re: Urgent: Complaint regarding SteadySeat Pro Incident

Dear Ms. Jenkins,

We acknowledge receipt of your complaint dated March 15, 2023. We are deeply sorry to hear about the incident involving your child and your SteadySeat Pro high chair.

Our Quality Assurance team is currently reviewing the details you have provided. We are in the process of contacting you to arrange the return of the unit for inspection. We will be in touch within 48 hours with next steps.

Sincerely,

Customer Support Team
Oakline Baby Gear

**From:** logistics@oaklinebabygear.com
**To:** Sarah Jenkins <s.jenkins@example.com>
**Date:** March 20, 2023, 14:30 PM
**Subject:** Replacement Unit Dispatched

Dear Ms. Jenkins,

Following our review of your case, we are pleased to inform you that a replacement SteadySeat Pro high chair has been dispatched to your address. The delivery is expected within 24 hours.

We apologize for the inconvenience caused by the original unit. Please ensure that you follow all safety guidelines outlined in the new manual, particularly regarding the securing of the safety harness.

Sincerely,

Oakline Baby Gear Logistics
